messages:
Samira: Heads up — seeing a ~15-25% perf regression on the INT4 path for sm90 at seq_len=4096 since yesterday's runtime deploy. Token throughput down, p95 up. Anyone else?

Mike: Yep, I repro'd locally. Quick perf dump:```
model=gpt-7b, arch=sm90, seq=4096
baseline (2026-03-10): 3800 tokens/s
current: 3120 tokens/s
p95 latency per token: 0.312ms -> 0.380ms
kernels: gemm_int4_sm90_v2 switched -> matmul_fp8_sm90_v1 fallback seen at layer 14
KV ops: multiple reallocs on cache warmup (see logs below)
```

Zhang: My hunch: workspace allocator heuristic changed which altered kernel selection. On sm90 the int4 kernel requires a slightly different workspace alignment and if allocator can't satisfy it we fall back to fp8 kernel which is slower end-to-end for these long sequences. Also batching heuristic tweak earlier this week increased average batch padding which interacts with KV cache warmup.

Mike: Posted a tiny profile snippet:```
# kernel picks by layer (layers 10-18)
layer 10: gemm_int4_sm90_v2 (ok)
layer 11: gemm_int4_sm90_v2
layer 12: matmul_fp8_sm90_v1 (fallback)  # workspace failure at alloc 24.5MB
layer 13: matmul_fp8_sm90_v1
layer 14: matmul_fp8_sm90_v1
```

Autotune-Bot: Queued autotune job: `autotune/1782345678-sm90-int4-ws-sweep` — will run ws_sweep + fallback_threshold sweep (ETA ~35m).

Josh: For a quick mitigation we can: 1) lower the int4 seqlen threshold for sm90 to 2048 so long runs use the stable path, 2) add a small hysteresis on kernel routing to avoid flip-flopping during warmup, and 3) tweak KV cache warmup to preallocate expected workspace on cold start. Example rollout command:```
# temporarily change kernel routing config in canary
redwoodctl config set runtime.kernel_priority.sm90 'int4,int8,fp8' --seqlen-threshold 2048 --hysteresis_ms 2000 --canary 10%
```

Samira: I'll push that canary now and collect per-route telemetry (tokens/sec, kernel_distribution, kv_reallocs). Also noticed KV cache shows reallocation when batch size changes due to new batching heuristic — might need to pin batch padding during warmup. :thinking_face:

Perf-Bot: Regression alert generated: `regression/4096-sm90-int4` — +18% median token latency vs baseline (last 7 days). Attaching synthetic test job id: `perf/1782345678-01`.

Zhang: Follow-ups: 1) Confirm if workspace allocator change was in commit `runtime#f3a2b7` (yesterday), 2) check whether sm86 vs sm90 autotune signatures differ (they do, need to merge manual overrides), 3) consider adding a quick hotspot that forces int4 workspace reservation during KV warmup.

Samira: Great. Plan: canary with Josh's config now, monitor autotune job results, if autotune finds a different kernel signature we'll accept only if tokens/sec >= baseline -5%. Will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
